source_candidate_correspondence.scope: Source app files, packaged verifier and all release frontend files match actual candidate bytes; dependencies were checked by the default relocated verifier. HEAD is not the artifact identity.

build_package_browser_inputs_unchanged.scope: Production sources, frontend sources/config/entries, locks and packaging/verifier scripts; generated assets have separate byte correspondence.

validation_policy: Independent runs keep actual states; no one-run 26-pass claim, no sum of T1-T4 totals. No production source changes; runtime and artifacts are bound by hashes, not HEAD alone.

runs.applicability: 24 pass and two new test-fixture/representation failures; intact JUnit is authoritative after wrapper stdout decoder error. Concurrent changes only to unused verification scripts/legacy mock comments, no production source or exercised Python test changes during this run.
Only the two failed existing nodes, after canonical list/tuple comparison and typed January fixture setup; no product changes.
Actual build exit 0 and complete stdout saved before wrapper terminal GBK printing failed; no duplicate build. Concurrent change to cost probe recording logic does not enter frontend build.

mismatch.assertions: Declared A finds unresolved frozen B; exact B trace retained; two slots counted once, one returned; A paid/remaining remain null.
mismatch.boundary: Synthetic in-memory TEMP-table corruption; main company remains valid. One caller-owned transaction with fresh QueryReads; no growth matrix or normal-state claim.

limits: One instrumented request per case with fresh request/connection/QueryReads, except caller-owned mismatch control; not OS cold cache or a latency SLA.
SQL/VM exclude Store connection setup and explicit integrity verification. VM interval is 100; category attribution and statement quantization are approximate.
Python tracemalloc includes instrumentation, response and caches; excludes SQLite native memory, OS cache and outcome observation sets. Elapsed time descriptive only.
Cash effects, all applicable classification scalars/issues, complete relevant manifests and source graphs retain necessary growth. No truncation or invented state.
Synthetic companies only; no installation, production database, deployment or formal backup. T4 evidence and test matrices are not rerun or combined.

recording_addendum.scope: Evidence recording only; no cost rerun or database construction
recording_addendum.change: Attach phase/sample mutable results before assertions; preserve completed and current measurements when a phase fails.
recording_addendum.verification: Passed recording-only simulated RuntimeError check; both completed sample and current measurement retained. No database created and no measurement executed.
recording_addendum.applicability: Actual performance numbers belong to the measured script hash. Core measurement, fixture growth and production dependencies unchanged; no claim that performance was rerun with the recording-only edit.

residuals.phenomenon: Client connection interruption during response write; error handler attempted a second write and logged WinError10053 stacks.
residuals.decision: No HTTP change, rebuild or added test batch in T5; preserve original stderr. WinError alone does not prove a unique network cause.
residuals.observed: read-only GET dispatch had returned; browser exit0, no page/API failures, later assertions and cleanup succeeded; no calculation/write failure evidence.

architecture_document_handoff: Architecture owns roadmap/task-prompts and overall acceptance; update only after its final review.
